# GJTL.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v2) with a 12-month target of Rp2,463.0 against Rp1,115.0 (expected total return 127.6%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: derated_compounder_rerating · method card: per fund record routing for Autos, components & dealerships.

Sharpest questions for a thesis:
- The base case carries Q4 2026 at a 20.3% gross margin (the 18.9% full-year input less the 2,640.5 nine-month gross profit on 4,754.8 of implied Q4 revenue). The stand-alone Q3 2026 margin is 13.9% (gross profit 738.457 o
- The bear's gross margin is base minus 1.5pp, i.e. 17.4% for FY2026E, which is 3.5pp above the 13.9% the company earned in Q3 2026 and only 1.0pp below the nine-month 18.4%. On the driver section 7 calls the single number
- The working-capital build is being funded by suppliers, and the report treats that only as an arithmetic offset. Trade payables rose from 2,049.2 to 3,859.8 (+88.4%) while cost of sales rose about 10%, against inventorie

**Regime AGAINST (set 2026-11-11 IDEATION).** Autos sit in the desk AVOID (consumer-discretionary, funding leg). Variant that beats it: GJTL earns a large share of revenue in USD exports against an IDR cost base, so the IDR funding-leg pressure the tilt cites is a translation tailwind here rather than a demand hit.
